note: The AI wingman's own replies to orders and its reports that are always the same, or differ only by a place (CoopBot, through WingmanReplies.Get). Blanks are {name}, filled as the personality's are. The wingman's stock voice is recorded from these (Tools/Voice/render_stock.py): a line with no blank once, a line whose only blanks are {place} or {field} once for each place and field in the star systems. Replies with numbers or people's names in them stay in CoopBot.cs and are spoken by the live voice.

mining the nearest asteroid field; I'll sell the ore when the hold is full.
not connected to anyone to give credits to.
there's nobody to give credits to.

I've not a whole credit to give.

orders: follow me / follow <name>, defend me (or "I'm under attack"), hold, attack [target] / attack my target / <target's name>, warp to <place>, dock, regroup, mine [<mineral> / the most valuable ore] [at <field>], sell, cargo, give [N] credits [to <name>], where are you, status; your name is <name>; chat on|off|pause|resume.
